facts.text: John has met LeBron a few times and describes him as real chill.

evidence.quote: I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience.

facts.text: John has seen LeBron play live and found it to be a learning experience.

evidence.quote: I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.

facts.text: John describes the experience of seeing LeBron play live as amazing with incredible energy.

evidence.quote: It was so amazing! The energy was crazy and everyone was so hyped.

facts.text: John mentions that seeing top players like LeBron motivates him to work harder.

evidence.quote: Seeing the top players was so motivating - it made me want to work even harder.
